name: DefiLlama Free API
summary: Free DeFi analytics: total value locked by protocol and chain, stablecoins, yields, DEX volumes, fees and token prices.
description: Open API for DeFi data across thousands of protocols. api.llama.fi serves TVL (protocols, chains, history), DEX and options volumes and fees; stablecoins.llama.fi serves stablecoin supply and chain distribution; yields.llama.fi serves APY and TVL for liquidity pools; coins.llama.fi serves current, historical and charted token prices by chain:address or coingecko:id. All free endpoints work without a key; a paid Pro API exists separately.

auth.notes: Free API on api.llama.fi, stablecoins.llama.fi, yields.llama.fi and coins.llama.fi needs no key. The paid Pro API (pro-api.llama.fi/{key}) is a separate service and endpoints exclusive to it return 402 on the free hosts.

rate_limit.summary: Described as 'Standard' on the free API with higher limits on the paid plan; no number published on the pages checked.

endpoints.summary: All protocols with current TVL and metadata
Historical TVL of one protocol with chain and token breakdown

license.name: Not stated on the docs pages checked; free API, attribution not required by the docs

coverage.temporal: Daily TVL history from 2017 for the chain aggregate

agent_notes: Use slugs from /protocols (for example aave, uniswap) for protocol endpoints. Prices are addressed as coingecko:<id> or <chain>:<address> in the coins host. Start with /protocols and /v2/chains for the overview; the detail endpoints are large (/protocol/uniswap was about 2 MB). /tvl/{slug} returns a bare number, not JSON.
caveats: Responses can be large: /protocols had about 9,000 entries, /yields/pools about 10 MB and /overview/dexs about 2.4 MB at check time.
No OpenAPI document was found at the obvious URLs; the docs site lists endpoints and an llms.txt.
Several different hosts (api, coins, stablecoins, yields) share the free API.
The main defillama.com/docs/api page sits behind a Cloudflare challenge; use api-docs.defillama.com.

verification.notes: Example executed keyless. /protocols, /v2/chains, stablecoins, yields, dexs and coins.llama.fi price/chart endpoints also returned 200; CORS * on two origins.
